orchestrator_handoff.summary: Capstone is ~80% synthesis of existing assets plus mechanical inclusion lemmas. The shared DerivationTree/Derivable framework + generic Derivable_mono lift make most cross-lattice monotonicity cheap cases-subsumptions. One genuinely hard direction (IK->K, Fischer-Servi primitive-diamond vs classical dual-diamond) is isolated and BLOCKED-gated.

key_conceptual_findings: Three distinct axes: (A) modal-axiom lattice, (B) propositional strength, (C) modal-over-propositional. Only Axis C and PL fragments are genuinely CONSERVATIVE (have converses); Axes A/B deliver MONOTONICITY only -- same-language converse is FALSE (T proves box-phi->phi; classical proves Peirce).
All four bases + all modal systems share ONE DerivationTree/Derivable framework over Proposition Atom, parameterized by Axioms predicate -- conservativity phrasable as axiom-predicate inclusion.
MK and CK are INCOMPARABLE (MK has cd/idb no efq; CK has efq no cd/idb); both embed into IK.
IK/MK/CK use PRIMITIVE diamond with Fischer-Servi axioms; classical K uses DUAL diamond (=not-box-not) with diaDuality -- so IK->K is not a rename.
CS4/CS5 completeness is BLOCKED upstream (task 501) but does NOT obstruct constructive-cube monotonicity (which is purely syntactic).
